component.name: LuxCanvas
component.summary: Projection mapping for walls, pillars and buildings
Videomappning för väggar, pelare och byggnader

description.p: LuxCanvas is free, open-source projection mapping (video mapping) software. Put video on any surface by dragging its corners until it fits – a wall, a pillar, a ball, a whole house. What you see in the editor is what the projector shows.

ul.li: Quad, triangle, ellipse and curved mesh surfaces, plus balls, pillars and cones where the image wraps around the object
Video files, images, live patterns, webcams and network streams
Masks with soft edges, blend modes, colour correction and snapping
Several projectors with keystone, edge blending and camera-assisted alignment
Effects in time with the music: edge lights, kaleidoscope, strobe and more, sound- and motion-reactive
Cues with crossfades, automatic timeline and schedule for installations
Phone remote, OSC, MIDI, DMX lights and LED pixel strips over Art-Net
Ready-made example shows for Christmas, Halloween and building façades

screenshot.caption: Example shows: effects, Christmas, Halloween and a façade illusion

description.p: Packaging for Flathub: newer runtime and access to the usual media folders instead of the whole home folder.
New name: LuxCanvas (formerly LumaMap). Settings move over automatically, and old OSC addresses still work.
3D objects (balls, pillars, cones), crossfades, multi-select, webcam motion, drawn lines of light, phone remote, schedule, Live clip grid and LED pixel strips.
